answer: Cheap identities are the whole attack, so the defence is making every claim cost real work. The karst holds work receipts rather than names, so the vine of a duplicated claim is visible before it can spread. Reaching the sparrow of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys. The design leans on invitation quota tree, revoked by a single upheld challenge, every claim is re-checked by someone with nothing to gain. Written in a cause and effect, two sentences register, it stays short.
